Based on my search, here are the number of MLA and MP seats in Telangana:

## MLA Seats (Legislative Assembly)

Telangana currently has **119 seats** in its Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha). This was established when the state was formed in 2014 under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014.

**Note:** There are plans to increase the assembly seats from **119 to 153** as outlined in Section 26 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014. However, this increase is currently on hold due to **Article 170(3)** of the Indian Constitution, which freezes delimitation of assembly constituencies until after the first census conducted post-2026. The Supreme Court dismissed a plea in July 2025 seeking early implementation of this increase, citing constitutional constraints.

## MP Seats (Parliament)

- **Lok Sabha (Lower House):** **17 seats**
- **Rajya Sabha (Upper House):** **7 seats**

So in total, Telangana has **24 MP seats** in Parliament (17 in Lok Sabha + 7 in Rajya Sabha).

---

|-------|-------|
| Legislative Assembly (MLA) | 119 (proposed increase to 153 after 2026) |
| Lok Sabha (MP) | 17 |
| Rajya Sabha (MP) | 7 |
